Definition: from G5449 in the primary sense of blowing; to inflate, i.e. (figuratively) make proud (haughty):--puff up.
BiblicalUsage: Physioo means to puff up, to inflate like a bladder. Paul warns that knowledge puffs up but love builds up in 1 Corinthians 8:1, and that love is not puffed up in 1 Corinthians 13:4. The Corinthians were puffed up for one teacher against another in 1 Corinthians 4:6, and the false teacher in Colossians 2:18 is vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe knowledge without love is just hot air — it makes a man bigger in his own eyes and smaller in God's. That is why I hold that the test of what I know is whether it makes me love my brother more.
